xmldoc.short_description: Control what happens when timer callbacks are still queued when a fixed-rate timer fires again.

description.p: Timer callback execution is serialized by the evaluator. A fixed-rate timer can fire again while a previous TimerFcn callback is still queued or running. The BusyMode property controls how Nelson resolves this conflict.

tr.td: Keep at most one pending callback for the timer. Extra firings are discarded.
Queue each firing. The timer can continue executing callbacks after the scheduled firing times have passed.
Stop the timer and execute ErrorFcn, then StopFcn if those callbacks are defined.

description.p: BusyMode applies to fixedRate execution. For fixedDelay and fixedSpacing, the next firing is scheduled after the callback completes, so callbacks do not pile up in the same way.

example_item.example_item_description: Use queue mode when every scheduled firing should be kept.
Use error mode to stop when the callback queue cannot keep up.
